name: Papershift
description: Papershift workforce management: shift plans, working sessions, absences, employees and locations. Public API v1, authenticated with an api_token query parameter.
instructions:
**Getting a token**
1. The Papershift API is a paid add-on: ask Papershift sales or your customer success manager to activate it for the account.
2. Sign in, click the gear icon (bottom left) → **Account Settings** → **API** tab → **Create New API Key**.
3. A new key has read and write permissions by default; restrict it to read if you only want reporting, then copy it into `PAPERSHIFT_API_TOKEN`. Anyone holding it can read the whole roster, so treat it as a password.

**The token travels as a query parameter**, not a header: Papershift's public API expects `?api_token=…` on every request. AnythingMCP appends it automatically (QUERY_AUTH), so it never appears in a tool's parameters and never has to be pasted into a prompt.

**Shift plan vs worked time.** Papershift keeps the two apart, and mixing them up is the usual source of wrong answers:
- `papershift_list_shifts` is the *plan* — which shifts are planned, where and when.
- `papershift_list_working_sessions` is the *record* — who actually clocked in and out.
A question about payroll wants working sessions; a question about next week wants shifts.

**Date ranges** are `range_start` and `range_end` (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Shifts and absences need both; working sessions need `range_start`. **Shifts also need a `location_id`**: call `papershift_list_locations` first.

**Paging** is `page` (1-based) with a fixed 25 rows per page; there is no page-size parameter. Locations and working areas come back in full, unpaged. Responses carry the rows under the resource name, e.g. `{"shifts": [...]}`, plus `next_page` when there is more.

**Language**: Papershift requires an `interface_language` on every request; the connector sends `de` automatically.

**Cloud reachability**: app.papershift.com is public with a valid certificate.

tools.name: papershift_list_users
tools.description: List employees (25 per page) with their name, e-mail, staff number and the locations and working areas they belong to. No parameters needed — the quickest check that the token is accepted.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (25 rows per page, fixed).

location_ids.description: Only users in these locations: comma-separated location ids.

working_area_ids.description: Only users in these working areas: comma-separated working area ids.

tools.name: papershift_get_user
tools.description: Read one employee by id: contact details, employment data, assigned locations and tags.

tools.name: papershift_list_locations
tools.description: List all locations (Standorte) of the account with their id, name, external id and status. Unpaged. Shifts need one of these ids.

tools.name: papershift_list_shifts
tools.description: Read the *planned* roster of one location in a date range: which shifts exist in which working area, when, and for how many employees. This is the plan, not what was actually worked. Needs a location_id from papershift_list_locations.

range_start.description: First day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD.

range_end.description: Last day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD.

location_id.description: Location id (required by Papershift); get it from papershift_list_locations.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (25 rows per page, fixed).

tools.name: papershift_list_working_sessions
tools.description: Read *actually worked* time in a date range — clock-in and clock-out, breaks and the resulting duration. This is what payroll is based on.

range_start.description: First day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD.

range_end.description: Last day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (25 rows per page, fixed).

tools.name: papershift_list_absences
tools.description: Read absences (holiday, sickness, special leave) in a date range with their type and approval state, to explain gaps in the roster.

range_start.description: First day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD.

range_end.description: Last day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (25 rows per page, fixed).

tools.name: papershift_list_working_areas
tools.description: List all working areas (Arbeitsbereiche) with their location — the roles a shift can be planned for, such as bar, kitchen or till. Unpaged.
